tokens.name: pp-purple
tokens.usage: PublishPress purple. Primary buttons, the current-step outline, progress fill, links. As text on `surface-raised` and `surface-page` (6.1:1 / 5.6:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: pp-purple-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons and hover color for links.

tokens.name: pp-purple-muted
tokens.usage: Accent meta pill ground and the running-status ground. Solid, so it does not change with the surface underneath.

tokens.name: pp-amber
tokens.usage: Future amber, from the plugin icon. Used only for the 'needs you' marker on manual and confirm gates, and in the log for warnings. Put `text-primary` (light) on it, never white.

tokens.name: pp-lavender
tokens.usage: Lavender tint from the PublishPress Cart icon (the back sheet). Used for brand moments only: the cover, illustration fills. Eyedropped from a screenshot, so confirm it against the source file. Not for text.

tokens.name: pp-indigo
tokens.usage: Deep indigo from the Cart banner ground. Used for brand moments only: the cover, marketing bands. `#ffffff` and `pp-amber` read on it. Eyedropped from a screenshot, so confirm it against the source file.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, step labels and body text on every surface. Also the fill of the Publish button.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Instructions, pill values and helper copy on `surface-page`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, phase titles, labels and hints on `surface-page` and `surface-raised` (5.3:1 or better). Was #78716c, which only reached 4.4:1 on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `pp-purple` fills (primary button). Turns dark in the dark theme because the purple gets lighter there.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background and the inside of an expanded step row.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Header, step rows, the current-step panel, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Meta pills, progress track, read-only fields, hover on rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Card and row outlines, dividers inside the header. Decorative only, so the contrast floor does not apply.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline, which is backed by a filled label.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover outline on secondary buttons, and the publish-boundary rule.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Text input outlines. Meets 3:1 against `surface-raised` in both themes, which `border-default` did not.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline on every control. Solid, 5.6:1 or better on every surface. Replaces the 35% alpha ring, which was below 3:1.

tokens.name: status-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Pending badge ground.

tokens.name: status-pending-fg
tokens.usage: Pending badge text and icon on `status-pending-bg`.

tokens.name: status-running-bg
tokens.usage: Running badge ground, shown while the engine executes an auto step.

tokens.name: status-running-fg
tokens.usage: Running badge text and spinner on `status-running-bg` (7.2:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-waiting-bg
tokens.usage: 'Needs you' badge ground. A manual or confirm gate is holding the pipeline.

tokens.name: status-waiting-fg
tokens.usage: 'Needs you' text and icon on `status-waiting-bg` (6.8:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-done-bg
tokens.usage: Done badge ground.

tokens.name: status-done-fg
tokens.usage: Done text and check icon on `status-done-bg`. Always shown with the check icon and the word, so it never depends on hue alone.

tokens.name: status-skipped-bg
tokens.usage: Skipped badge ground.

tokens.name: status-skipped-fg
tokens.usage: Skipped text and icon on `status-skipped-bg`.

tokens.name: status-failed-bg
tokens.usage: Failed badge ground and the failure message box in the current-step panel.

tokens.name: status-failed-fg
tokens.usage: Failed text and X icon on `status-failed-bg` (5.9:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: alert-security-bg
tokens.usage: Security-release banner ground.

tokens.name: alert-security-border
tokens.usage: Security-release banner outline.

tokens.name: alert-security-fg
tokens.usage: Security-release banner text on `alert-security-bg`.

tokens.name: log-bg
tokens.usage: Log panel ground. The log is dark in both themes.

tokens.name: log-border
tokens.usage: Log panel outline.

tokens.name: log-fg
tokens.usage: Plain command output on `log-bg`.

tokens.name: log-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, the placeholder and runner meta lines on `log-bg` (6.9:1). Replaces #78716c, which was 3.6:1.

tokens.name: log-cmd
tokens.usage: The echoed `$ command` line on `log-bg`.

tokens.name: log-ok
tokens.usage: Success summary lines on `log-bg`.

tokens.name: log-warn
tokens.usage: Warnings on `log-bg`, such as the WARN from check:wporg during the cooldown.

tokens.name: log-err
tokens.usage: stderr and failure lines on `log-bg`.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "Source Code Pro", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: App title in the sticky header.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Current-step title, dialog title, empty-state title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Start a versioned release for this working copy.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Step row labels and button labels. The current row uses weight 600.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Tag the merged master commit. Do not move the tag after deploy workflows start.
styles.usage: Step instructions, dialog descriptions, pill values.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Phase titles and panel eyebrows, uppercased.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges and step-type tags, uppercased.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline commands in instructions and hints.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label, and under eyebrows.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and buttons, and between rows in a form.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Step-row padding and the inside of the log.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between phases.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Header side padding, gap between the step list and the current-step panel.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding and the page's bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the log panel, message boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Step rows and alert banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Header, the current-step panel, dialogs, the empty state.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Meta pills, badges, step-type tags, the progress track.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Header and empty state.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The current-step panel and dialogs.
